source_pdf.title: Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture, Edition1.1

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Nature and conceptual relationships of mission and management information; DIV-1 expressed using entity relationship diagrams
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: The narrative does not enumerate or authenticate underlying SOSA DSDM entities/classes
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Refines DIV-1 entities and associations with measurements, units and coordinate systems
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Not concrete wire serialization, exact measurement value or model ontology of our DIM
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Intended physical data representation, precise structures, bounds and encodings
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Physical data model is not physical sensor equipment or extracted verified schema; native file not inspected
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: DIV-1 separates mission/sensed-environment information from system-control/operational information
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Not a mandatory two-module DIM design, general CSAPI Profile structure or universal class taxonomy
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: A data item may be transported by different methods separately from its definition
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Not evidence that SOSA wire message equals OGC SWE, SensorML, OMS or ISA Event
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.topic: Normative DSDM and IDL file pointers
source_native_concepts.original_meaning: C239 explicitly references a separate SOSA_TechStd_v1_DSDM and SOSA_TechStd_v1_DSDM_IDL
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: A file reference is not inspection of native entity definitions, attributes, cardinalities or IDL encoding
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: FACE OSS, Container and Virtual Machine are distinct RTE profiles with conditional Rules 14.1-1–4
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Software runtime host does not prove physical host platform or exact one-module/one-container correspondence
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: RTE-specific configuration requirements include ProfileType, ImageLoad, Resources and conditional FileSystem/StartOrder entries
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Not identical to ISA Config message, SensorML configuration, sensor control action or generic mandatory DIM fields
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.topic: Software module to RTE containment is flexible
source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Multiple modules/profiles can coexist and a module may be implemented by multiple executables or containers
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: One runtime does not imply one physical sensor or a fixed physical hardware relationship
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.topic: Interactions are operations with parameters and roles
source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Interaction can be operation/function with DIV-2 input/output parameters between modular entities acting as provider and consumer
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Not a performed observation, authenticated command history or native CSAPI Command directly
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.topic: Message Interconnect vs Wideband Low-Latency Interconnect
source_native_concepts.original_meaning: SOSA distinguishes general management/communication from high-volume/low-latency signal streams and control
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Transport path is not physical mounted equipment, one sensor channel or raw observation
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.topic: Eight interaction classes and default transports
source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Analog Distribution, Digital Signal Stream, Digital Signal Context, Signal Layer Control, Discrete, Publish-Subscribe, Request-Response and Event Notification have different roles/default paths
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Not eight mandatory DIM classes or proof each implemented by any examined case
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.topic: Digital Signal Stream vs Digital Signal Context
source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Digital data payloads and associated contextual metadata are separable, possibly transported at different rates
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Context metadata is not original-source observation performer or data-provenance assertion
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Publisher/subscriber interaction shares identified structured data via topics; source says exact general pub/sub implementation not yet fully determined
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Topic ID is not physical sensor identity, ISA subscription Query ID or CSAPI DataStream URI
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Client/requestor and service/responder interaction for get/set operations; response direction/flow varies
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: A request plus response does not independently prove hardware physical effects or completion
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Event notifications are event-triggered subcase of pub/sub and may be acknowledgeable
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Cannot equate generic event notice to source-authenticated performed OMS Observation
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Publisher/consumer offered/required QoS attributes, policies and compatibility
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: QoS is transport interoperability property, not observed sensor phenomenon or DIM-class requirement
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Data Definition, Encoding, Encapsulation, Transport, Network are selected as one interaction binding
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Do not collapse model semantics and wire format, or infer one fixed implementation universally
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Conditional General Message Interconnect stacks: OMG DDS/RTPS v1.4+, Protobuf v3 + AMQP v1.0, or Protobuf v3 + ZMTP v3.0
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Rules apply under stated implementation conditions; they do not require these transport choices in CSAPI and do not supply actual DSDM entity schema
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: Conditional FACE 3.1 Transport Service/Distribution/Configuration/QoS capabilities for a SOSA software-module Transport API
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: This source rule does not make FACE API a CSAPI client interface or physical interconnection
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: If network protocol and security-required conditions apply, module interaction can require TLS/DTLS configurability
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Not proof that any source device is cryptographically authenticated or source evidence signed
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.topic: Six referenced management OpenAPI companion files
source_native_concepts.original_meaning: C239 specifically identifies six separate System Manager, Generic Module, Security Services, Chassis Manager, PIC and PIC/SW RTE OpenAPI files
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Named but native JSON not read: cannot claim endpoints, properties, schemas or successful API conformance
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

source_native_concepts.original_meaning: §5.7 sends reader to B.2 for data model, while Appendix B.1 is DSDM and B.2 is System Manager API
source_native_concepts.negative_equivalence: Record original contradiction without silently fabricating original normative class or rewriting standard
source_native_concepts.source: The Open Group, Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture Edition 1.1 (C239, June 2023, September erratum), original project Library c239_5.pdf file_00000000af4081f58c4bac329f85c58f

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: SOSA DIV-1 mission/management conceptual scope may help categorize output and management fields
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: SOSA DIV-1 is a model layer, not output-field specification or native CSAPI result schema

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Logical quantities and physical format concepts may inform typed measured data
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Narrative alone cannot establish a native SOSA measurement type/units, actual value or cardinality

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Physical DSDM encoding pointer is related to datatype specification scope
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Cannot infer DSDM type list from prose or equate to ISA CCD type declarations

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: SOSA RTE software profile/configuration has documented fields
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: It is not native ISA Config message, component capability declaration, runtime configuration of all sensors

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Multiple execution environments/implementations illustrate physical vs logical distinctions
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: No physical containment or one module per PIC, sensor or hardware component

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Request-response interactions describe a request to act or get/set operation
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Not evidence of a source-attested issued command/physical effect

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Response exists as an interaction type after request
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Response does not independently substantiate completed task or physical effect

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Interconnect roles/families help explain reporting paths and transport differences
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Source case has no verified SOSA link or real stream implementation

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Signal streams and context metadata are separable from data record output fields
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: No direct SWE DataRecord or CSAPI DataStream/resultSchema equivalence

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: SOSA topics identify pub/sub shared structures
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: No equivalent ISA Query object, source UCI or CSAPI Datastream identity

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Event notifications cover operational/management state changes
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: SOSA notification not ISA administrative event code nor original performed Observation

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Native SOSA interaction binding specifies serialization/transport stacks under source conditions
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: ISA presentation negotiation and SOSA Table15.4 stacks not same protocol requirement

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: Request/response roles exist in SOSA interactions
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: No native original request ID or ISA response correlation reference established by these pages

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: SOSA interaction publisher/sender is digital role
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Publishing data does not prove which physical sensor performed source observation

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: SOSA mission/management split and its data models are relevant background to provenance design
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Cannot infer exact user-proposed source-qualified assertion field or issuer/evidence clause in DSDM

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: SOSA digital stream or event notification can produce data representations
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: Does not define original NOAA source observation vs experimental CSAPI copy provenance

staged_correspondences.source_first_justification: QoS policies can qualify a reporting path
staged_correspondences.negative_equivalence_guard: No actual source case has demonstrated SOSA QoS policy, delivery or latency
